items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23
items.q: No, Crockett. See, I belong to that.

ctx.x: I can't take all that stuff. Did they have a band?
Did they have a band? They had music? Oh, no, no. I belong to one of the companies that did that parade. But didn't they have any music? No, Crockett. See, I belong to that. Did they have any music?
